rationale: The stock is printing at the absolute high of today's range with only 18,189 shares of volume in the first two minutes and a 150 bps bid-ask spread — crossing the spread alone costs ~$0.19 per share on a $12.63 name, which immediately eats any edge. While prior-day momentum (a ~20% intraday rally on 4.8M shares) and the gap-up are notable, today's volume is thin enough that price discovery is unreliable, and there is no news headline to justify a directional catalyst. The liquidity and transaction-cost profile make any directional entry mechanically unfavorable at this moment.
